svg.text: A refined operational workspace for The Unplugged Wear.
White surfaces and clear dark text
Use colour by purpose. Reserve saturated fills for actions and meaningful feedback.
Status labels carry meaning alongside colour, including in order lists and payment alerts.
A consistent family across headings, navigation, forms, tables and numeric data.
44px controls. A 4px spacing grid. Consistent radii keep the interface composed.
A realistic dashboard specimen combines neutral surfaces, Urbanist and focused purple actions.
Sample data shown for layout reference.
Body: 14–16px. Metadata: 12px. Use visible focus outlines and labels for every status.
THE UNPLUGGED WEAR / DESIGN SYSTEM V2 / URBANIST
